prompt: /small-safe-steps Migrate our email sending from SendGrid to AWS SES

assertions.text: Identifies this as a service replacement — a risky change that needs expand-contract
Expand phase includes sending via BOTH SendGrid and SES simultaneously (dual-send) before switching
Migrate phase proposes gradual traffic routing (feature flag, percentage rollout, or canary) rather than a hard cutover
Includes an explicit monitoring/verification step after routing traffic to new service before removing old one
Contract phase removes SendGrid only after confirming zero usage — not immediately after 100% routing
Includes a learning step (time-boxed investigation) to understand current SendGrid usage before building anything
Each individual step is scoped to 1-3 hours maximum
